input.overview: Complete B-A-L-L in the lower lanes to start Eight Ball Fury's shortest Multiball. For three-ball Multiball, complete E-I-G-H-T in the top lanes three times, then hit the MULTI and BALL targets beside the horseshoe. The longer drop-target challenge advances into the numbered-ball challenge and four-ball Multiball.
input.simpleOverview: Complete B-A-L-L in the lower rollover lanes for the shortest Multiball. For the larger route, complete E-I-G-H-T in the top lanes three times, then hit the MULTI and BALL targets beside the horseshoe to start three-ball Multiball.
input.summary: Use the flipper buttons to move the lit rollover lane. Complete B-A-L-L in the lower lanes for two-ball Multiball, or complete E-I-G-H-T in the top lanes three times and then hit both targets beside the horseshoe for three-ball Multiball.

quickInfo.name: Two-ball Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Complete the four B-A-L-L lower lanes; this also raises the spinner to 1,000 points per spin.

quickInfo.name: Three-ball Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Complete E-I-G-H-T three times for three virtual locks, then hit the MULTI and BALL targets beside the horseshoe.

quickInfo.name: Four-ball Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Finish all six pocket drops in the first timed challenge, then finish the assigned seven numbered balls and center 8-ball.

quickInfo.name: Horseshoe
quickInfo.summary: Alternate horseshoe entries to raise end-of-ball Bonus X from 2X through 5X and then light Extra Ball.

steps.text: Use the flipper buttons to move the lit lower rollover and complete B-A-L-L to start two-ball Multiball.
For three-ball Multiball, complete E-I-G-H-T in the five top lanes three times; each completion records one virtual lock.
After the third virtual lock, hit the MULTI and BALL targets on the two sides of the center horseshoe to start three-ball Multiball.
During three-ball Multiball, follow the alternating Jackpot and Super Jackpot lamps rather than repeating one unlit shot.
Hit any pocket drop target to begin the first timed challenge, then knock down all six before time expires; each successful drop adds time.
In the next challenge, complete the seven numbered balls assigned to your side and then the center 8-ball; successful targets add time here too.
Completing the numbered-ball challenge starts four-ball Multiball. Follow the alternating Jackpot and Super Jackpot lamps.
After three- or four-ball Multiball ends, the Pocket Challenge asks for three indicated pairs of pocket drops and finishes with a 100,000-point Jackpot.

playfieldReferences.description: The five rollover lanes used for the three virtual locks.

playfieldReferences.description: The four lower rollovers that start two-ball Multiball.

playfieldReferences.label: Horseshoe and MULTI/BALL targets
playfieldReferences.description: The center loop and two standups used to finish the three-ball start.

playfieldReferences.label: Pocket challenge drops
playfieldReferences.description: The six individual drops used by the timed challenge sequence.

cautions.issue: Challenge timers and the minimum ball-return period are adjustable.
cautions.response: Version 3 describes a 10-second minimum play period and default challenge times of 40 and 50 seconds; use the display if the operator changed them.

cautions.issue: An older rules transcription says the minimum play period is 30 seconds.
cautions.response: Use the current official Version 3 value of 10 seconds; this does not change any qualification or start instruction.
